abyssal_brand.name: Abyssal Brand
abyssal_brand.desc: Permanently corrupts an unequipped item at the Blacksmith. May destroy it.

scrap.name: Scrap
scrap.desc: Salvaged metal. Used to upgrade equipment.

iron_fragment.name: Iron Fragment
iron_fragment.desc: Upgrades item base damage and defence.

arcane_dust.name: Arcane Dust
arcane_dust.desc: Rerolls an affix on an item.

monster_core.name: Monster Core
monster_core.desc: Removes an affix from an item.

catalyst.name: Rare Catalyst
catalyst.desc: Adds an affix to an item with a free slot.

glaze_flake.name: Glaze Flake
glaze_flake.desc: Peeled from a Glazed Elite. Crafts Glazed Pigments at the Easel (Atlas of Ruin).

pigment_dust.name: Pigment Dust
pigment_dust.desc: Scraped from a painted sketch. Crafts Unfinished Pigments at the Easel (Atlas of Ruin).

caster._doc: Caster itemisation (docs/CASTER_ITEMISATION.md). Flat added damage to spells is scaled by effectiveness = the spell's base-damage average / added_ref, clamped to eff_min..eff_max (a skill may set added_eff), x (1 + 4% per skill level). overcap: skill levels from items may exceed the natural skill level cap by this much; natural and corruption levels still stop at the cap.
